agent-manifest.description: Deterministic scheduling store: lists providers and their open slots, commits and cancels appointments, and holds the appointment records. It makes no clinical or coverage judgments — it only keeps the calendar consistent.

offer.body: The currently open slots per provider. A slot is bookable only while it appears here.
Commit an appointment to a slot with an idempotency key, returning the created record — or a structured slot_taken refusal if the slot was booked in the meantime.
Release the slot held by an appointment (on cancellation, or the old slot of a reschedule).
The appointment records, used to list a patient's appointments and to confirm ownership before a change.
Two appointments are never committed to the same provider slot; the commit is refused when the slot is already taken. Kept in code (services/schedule.py) regardless of any agent's behavior.

use.body: Bookings and cancellations are keyed to the verified patient the registry publishes.
